fullPassage: The English word opera is an abbreviation of the Italian phrase opera in musica ("work in music"). It is a story told strictly to music, mainly sung from beginning to end. What makes opera so powerful is the combination of words and music to transmit emotions in a play. In opera, you can find the same emotion that we experience in our daily lives, such as love, jealousy, betrayal, friendship, or conflict. By identifying ourselves with the characters and situations presented on stage, we recognize in them part of our own character. The large emotional impact is what makes opera a source for such powerful, intense enjoyment, which leads so many people to fall in love with this great performing art. Opera is not dying; it is just evolving.

questions.stem:
주어진 문장들을 글의 흐름에 맞게 배열한 것은?

(A) What makes opera so powerful is the combination of words and music to transmit emotions in a play.
(B) The English word opera is an abbreviation of the Italian phrase opera in musica.
(C) It is a story told strictly to music, mainly sung from beginning to end.

det.analysis:
✅ ③ (B)-(C)-(A): (B) opera의 어원 → (C) 음악에 맞춰 노래하는 이야기 → (A) 말과 음악의 결합이 핵심.
❌ ① (A)-(B)-(C): 핵심 요소가 먼저 나오면 맥락 없음.
❌ ② (C)-(B)-(A): 정의가 먼저 나오면 어원이 뒤늦음.
❌ ④ (B)-(A)-(C): 어원 바로 뒤에 핵심 요소는 성급.

det.korean: C(일상 감정) → B(동일시) → A(감정적 영향) → D(결론).

❌ ① (A)-(B)-(C)-(D): 영향이 먼저 나오면 원인 없음.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (   ) 쓰시오. (1단어 (영어로))

det.analysis: 빈칸 뒤 명사 response 앞이므로 형용사. emotion → emotional.

questions.passage: Opera is a powerful form of __________ (perform) art that transmits emotions through music.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (   ) 쓰시오. (1단어 (영어로))

det.analysis: 빈칸 뒤 명사 art를 수식하는 형용사 필요. perform → performing. performing art = 공연 예술.
